page_title: Perch: the fastest way back to your agents

sources.entry: Perch - Keyboard-first MacBook notch app for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and pi sessions: see what each did, answer from the notch, and jump back to the exact window or terminal pane. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/asafofer/perch) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Perch
summary.one_liner: Perch is a free, open-source Mac menu-notch app that shows what your Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and pi coding sessions did while you were away and lets you answer them or jump back in.
use_cases: check what coding agents did while away
approve or deny agent commands without switching windows
reply to a coding agent from the notch
jump back to the exact terminal tab or pane of an agent session
get notified when an agent session finishes or needs input
summary.what_it_does: Perch lives in the notch of a Mac and expands when a coding agent session finishes or asks for something. It shows a card with what the agent did and the next step it named. You can allow or deny a command, or pick an answer to a question, from the notch. You can read the agent's last message and reply in place, and one key opens the exact session in the Claude or Codex app, Conductor, a terminal tab, a cmux split or a herdr pane. An optional setting adds a hook for Claude Code and Codex and a small plugin for OpenCode and pi so Perch learns when sessions finish or need approval. Perch reads the session files already on the Mac and says it does not send sessions, prompts or code off the machine.
notable: Lives in the MacBook notch and surfaces only when a session finishes or needs input
Jumps to the exact terminal tab, cmux split, herdr pane or Conductor workspace
Reads local session files; goes online only for update checks and optional feedback
Signed and notarized by Apple, with self-updating
caveats: Requires macOS 15 or later and an Apple silicon Mac
Needs Accessibility and Automation permissions for the shortcut, replies and terminal switching; without Accessibility, replies are copied for manual pasting
The hook/plugin setup is optional and modifies agent config files (backed up first)
